questions.title: In a bathroom
questions.hint: Fixtures, products and anything else you'd find there.
rules: Things you'd normally find in a home bathroom count.
Different names for one thing count once.
Brands count as the thing they are: Colgate is toothpaste.

questions.title: Languages
questions.hint: Any language people speak, sign or once spoke.
rules: Any real human language counts, living or dead, signed languages included.
Programming languages and made-up languages don't count.
Dialects count as their language: Mandarin and Cantonese are separate, American English is English.

questions.title: -UMP words
questions.prompt: Name a word that ends in UMP
rules: Any real English word that ends in UMP.
Forms of one word count once: the plural, and verb forms like -ed and -ing.
Names of people, places and brands don't count.
